game.title: Until Dawn
game.blurb: Remake of the 2015 interactive horror drama, from Ballistic Moon, released 2024-10-04. RAWG average playtime: 9 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapter order follows the StrategyWiki walkthrough of the original game (CC BY-SA 4.0), grouped a few chapters at a time.

chapters.title: Chapters 1 to 4
chapters.summary: The friends return to the mountain and the first night begins to go wrong.

chapters.title: Chapters 5 to 7
chapters.summary: The group splits up and the danger grows. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Chapters 8 to 10 and the Epilogue
chapters.summary: The last hours before dawn and the aftermath. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Choices, Survivors and Endings
chapters.summary: Who makes it to dawn, key choices, a full playthrough and the hidden story moments. Spoiler-guarded.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 2172010)
Wiki structure from StrategyWiki under CC BY-SA 4.0 (chapter order from its walkthrough contents; titles reworded, no text copied) — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Until_Dawn
Fandom (untildawn.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://untildawn.fandom.com/wiki/Until_Dawn
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Remake of the 2015 game: it uses its own Steam app, 2172010 ("Until Dawn™"), and RAWG's remake entry until-dawn-2 (id 976005, "Until Dawn (Remake)"), not the 2015 entry. Route cc-by-sa: StrategyWiki (CC BY-SA 4.0) has the guide under "Until Dawn" at completion stage 4, but its categories (2015, PlayStation 4) show it was written for the original. All its walkthrough pages are written: Prologue, Chapter 1 to Chapter 10 and Epilogue (about 2,600 to 13,400 characters each), plus Clues (about 23,000), Characters, Totems, Trophies, Controls and Gameplay, about 129,000 characters in all. Chapters follow its contents order, grouped three or four at a time; the remake's chapter order should be checked against it before guide text is written. No text was copied. untildawn.fandom.com answers the API with about 76 linked articles on its "Until Dawn" page, and a separate "Until Dawn (2024 Remake)" page links about 67; names only were looked at. 16 of 29 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the choices and endings chapter with the survival and playthrough achievements, since the data does not say which chapter each belongs to.
